svg.title: Figure CV-2. Uncoupling a tractor-semitrailer
svg.desc: Sequence condensed from CA Commercial Driver Handbook DL 650 (REV 12/2019) section 6.4.2 (uncoupling tractor-semitrailers). Follow the handbook steps and any equipment-specific procedure for your vehicle.

text.tspan: Level, firm ground. Chock the trailer wheels. Ease
pressure off the fifth-wheel locking jaws by
backing up gently and then applying the parking

text.tspan: Lower it until it makes firm contact. In winter or
soft ground, use enough extra turns or a pad if
needed so the trailer will not sink.

text.tspan: Pull the tractor forward until the fifth wheel
just clears the trailer, then stop. Do not get the
tractor caught under a dropping trailer.

text.tspan: Walk around: check that the surface will support
the trailer, lines are secure on the tractor, and
the area is clear before driving away.
